title: Dual Range
description: Two thumbs on one track: the price-range slider every filter sidebar actually needs.
usage: Two native range inputs share one track; the fill between the thumbs is the selection, and the script keeps a minimum gap so the thumbs cannot cross into nonsense. Values mirror into the outputs beside it — wire those to your filter, and the URL if you are serious. Steps, min and max are plain attributes on the inputs.
a11y: Both thumbs are real range inputs with their own labels ("Minimum price", "Maximum price"), fully keyboard-operable with arrow keys — only the overlapping track is custom paint. The visible numbers are outputs tied to the inputs, so what is announced is what is shown.
